articles.title: Harry Styles, Billie Eilish and Cher to Headline Glastonbury 2027
articles.summary: Glastonbury 2027 will be headlined by Harry Styles, Billie Eilish, Cher and Sam Fender, running 23–27 June at Worthy Farm.

articles.title: Swimming League Splashes Back With Star-Studded All-Star Match
articles.summary: The International Swimming League returns on 19 December with an All-Star Match in London, headlined by Adam Ramsay-Peaty.

articles.title: After 28 Years on Foot, Karl Bushby Finally Walks Home
articles.summary: Karl Bushby has become the first person to circle the world on foot or by swimming, arriving home in Hull on 2 November 2026 after 28 years.
